partners.mechanism_chain: ENPP1 (HGNC:3356) —DISRUPTS→ Inorganic pyrophosphate (PPi) (CHEBI:17602); Inorganic pyrophosphate (PPi) (CHEBI:17602) —DECREASES→ Extracellular matrix mineralization (REACT:R-HSA-74772); Extracellular matrix mineralization (REACT:R-HSA-74772) —LEADS_TO→ Arterial calcification (HP:0005794); ENPP1 (HGNC:3356) —DECREASES→ Phosphate (CHEBI:17954); Phosphate (CHEBI:17954) —LEADS_TO→ Rickets (HP:0003172). Loss-of-function mutations in ENPP1 lead to reduced hydrolysis of extracellular pyrophosphate (PPi), resulting in increased PPi levels. High PPi inhibits hydroxyapatite crystal formation, thus normally preventing pathological calcification. However, ENPP1 also plays a role in phosphate homeostasis. Loss of ENPP1 function can lead to altered phosphate metabolism, contributing to rickets.
